name: mokxi
description: Build Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico circuits with code from ChatGPT. Mokxi checks the circuit and returns a link that opens and runs it in the Mokxi browser simulator.

interface.longDescription: Mokxi turns a plain request into a working electronics project. ChatGPT picks a board and parts from Mokxi's catalog of 500+ parts and 44 boards (Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico, STM32 and more), wires them, writes the sketch, checks the circuit the way the Mokxi editor does, and returns a link that opens and runs the project in the Mokxi browser simulator. Good for students, teachers and hobbyists who want to try an idea before buying parts. Limitations: Mokxi simulates circuits; it does not control real hardware. Signing in to Mokxi is required.
defaultPrompt: Build an Arduino traffic light with three LEDs and give me the Mokxi link.
Make an ESP32 that shows the temperature from a DHT22 on an OLED.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists boards such as Arduino Uno, Nano, Mega, ESP32 variants and Raspberry Pi Pico from the tool result, without inventing boards.

positive.description: Find a part and its pins
positive.prompt: What pins does the DHT22 sensor have in Mokxi?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the DHT22 part and reports its pins (power, data, ground) from the tool result.

positive.prompt: Build an Arduino Uno that blinks an LED on pin 13 and give me the Mokxi link.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a valid project with an Uno, an LED and a resistor, validates it, and returns a mokxi.com link that opens the project ready to run.

positive.description: Build an ESP32 sensor and display project
positive.prompt: Make an ESP32 that reads a DHT22 and shows the temperature on an SSD1306 OLED, then give me the Mokxi link.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks an ESP32, a DHT22 and an SSD1306, wires them, writes the sketch, validates it and returns a working mokxi.com link.

positive.description: Fix a project that fails the check
positive.prompt: Build an Arduino with a button that turns on an LED, check it, and fix anything the check reports before giving me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates the project, corrects any reported wiring or code problem, validates again, and only then returns the link.

negative.description: Real hardware control is out of scope
negative.prompt: Turn on the relay connected to my real Arduino at home.
Book me a table for two tonight.
Show me how to wire 240V mains directly to my Arduino pins.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments. Mokxi plans are bought on mokxi.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: list boards, search parts, check a project and create a runnable Mokxi link, plus a circuit-building skill.
